tools.name: m1_rdap
tools.description: Look up domain registration data via RDAP. Returns registration status, creation date, expiry date, registrar, and age-based multiplier.

tools.name: m2_tld_table
tools.description: Score the TLD (Top-Level Domain) based on market demand. Returns TLD score (0.2-10) and weight profile.

tools.name: m3_length
tools.description: Score the domain based on SLD length. Returns sigmoid-based multiplier with digit penalty.

tools.name: m4_word_count
tools.description: Score based on word count from segmentation. Single-word gets highest multiplier.

tools.name: m5_pronounce
tools.description: Score pronounceability using vowel ratio, consonant clusters, and bigram frequency.

tools.name: m6_segmenter
tools.description: Segment domain name into words and determine commercial intent (high/mid/low/brandable).

tools.name: m7_keyword
tools.description: Grade keyword commercial intent using curated wordlists.

tools.name: m8_cpc
tools.description: Evaluate CPC tier from word lists with substring fallback.

tools.name: m8_spam
tools.description: Check domain against spam blacklists (Spamhaus DBL/ZRD, URIBL, SURBL). Returns spam severity and multiplier.

tools.name: m9_search
tools.description: AI agent tool: search the web for domain web presence, competitor count, and common law trademark signals.

tools.name: m10_cross
tools.description: Check if the SLD is registered in other popular TLDs (.com, .net, .co, .io).

tools.name: m11_trademark
tools.description: Check for trademark conflicts using Signa.so API.

tools.name: m11_dns_history
tools.description: Get domain ownership history via WhoisXML API. Returns drops, registrar changes, years active, and registrant info.

tools.name: m12_authority
tools.description: Measure domain authority using WhoisXML Domain Reputation API. Returns reputation score, risk level, and parked status.

tools.name: m13_confidence
tools.description: Compute overall appraisal confidence from module completeness.

tools.name: m14_social
tools.description: Check social media handle availability for the domain name across major platforms.

tools.name: m15_pricing
tools.description: Convert all module multipliers into a dollar estimate with range.

tools.name: m16_brandability
tools.description: Rate brandable domain quality using syllable flow, pattern matching, and length scoring.

tools.name: search_domain
tools.description: Check domain availability and basic info via RDAP. Returns availability status, registrar, expiry, and nameservers.
